title: Mara and the Glasshouse
author: Jonah Quintana
blurb: Bram Ashgrove, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
